ROHITH VENKATESH Fund Accounting | NAV Operations | Hedge Fund, Private Equity, Real Estate & Crypto Funds

Bengaluru, India 560043 | +91 9481470162 | roh_09121994@yahoo.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Finance MBA with 5+ years of progressive experience in fund accounting, NAV operations, and financial reporting across private equity, real estate, and digital asset (crypto) fund structures — core disciplines directly transferable to hedge fund and alternative investment fund administration. Currently supporting Goldman Sachs Asset Management's real estate fund operations through a consulting engagement with Grant Thornton, preparing and reviewing NAV files, managing capital call processing and investor allocations, and supporting audit and due diligence. Proficient in Geneva, Investran, Lemon Edge, and Solvas. Known for sharp attention to detail, strong client and onshore team coordination, and a consistent record of driving process efficiency within tight SLA environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

NAV Calculations & NAV File Review

Investor Allocations & Reporting

Capital Calls & Distributions

Performance & Management Fee Calculations

Financial Statement Preparation

Trade Capture & Reconciliation

Audit, Due Diligence & Compliance Support

Quality Assurance & Controls Review

Alternative Fund Structures (PE, RE, Crypto)

SLA & Deadline Management

Process Improvement & Automation

Client & Onshore Team Coordination

Systems: Geneva · Investran · Lemon Edge · Solvas · MS Office Suite

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Real Estate Fund Accounting Analyst

Oct 2025 –

CGB SOLUTIONS Present Goldman Sachs Asset Management (Consulting Engagement via Grant Thornton) | Bengaluru

Support accounting and reporting across real estate investment structures, managing capital call

processing, distribution waterfalls, and investor-level allocations with precision

Prepare and review Net Asset Value (NAV) files and perform variance analysis to ensure accurate fund

valuations and timely reporting across reporting cycles

Assist in the preparation of financial statements and investor reports that directly support portfolio

decision-making and LP communications

Perform quality assurance checks on data received from internal support functions ahead of client

delivery

Collaborate with global cross-functional teams on fund performance analysis, ensuring alignment on

reporting timelines and deliverable quality

Contribute to audit and due diligence processes, maintaining rigorous data accuracy and adherence to

regulatory and compliance standards

Associate Manager – Fund Accounting

May 2024 – Sep 2025

Formidium | Bengaluru

• Led fund accounting operations for a portfolio of traditional and crypto funds, managing the full

accounting lifecycle from trade capture through client-facing reporting

• Oversaw end-to-end fund accounting for both traditional and digital asset (crypto) fund structures,

ensuring accuracy across NAV computations, fee calculations, and reconciliations

Managed trade capture, position reconciliations, and portfolio-level reporting for crypto fund clients,

adapting to the unique settlement and valuation mechanics of digital assets

Calculated management and performance fees in line with fund LPAs and investor agreements, resolving

discrepancies proactively before reporting deadlines

Coordinated with onshore teams and auditors during financial reviews and year-end audits, ensuring all

deliverables met compliance and SLA requirements

Identified and implemented process improvement and automation initiatives, reducing manual

intervention across key accounting workflows

Systems Used: Geneva, Investran, Solvas

Associate – Fund Accounting Apex Funds Financial Services | Bengaluru

Jun 2020 – May 2024

Contributed to fund accounting operations for a global leader in private equity fund administration,

progressing from execution to review responsibilities over four years

Prepared and reviewed financial statements for private equity funds, ensuring accuracy and adherence to

applicable accounting standards

Managed trade capture, position reconciliations, and audit processes across multiple fund mandates

simultaneously

Served as the primary point of contact for onshore teams and clients, resolving accounting queries with a

focus on speed and accuracy

Maintained strict SLA adherence across reporting deliverables and implemented efficiency initiatives that

reduced average turnaround time by 15%

Intern – Fund Accounting

Apr 2019 – Jun 2019

JMarathon Advisory Services | Bengaluru

Gained foundational exposure to equity research, stock market analysis, and portfolio management

principles

Developed and back-tested trading strategies, preparing structured analytical reports for senior advisors

EDUCATION

MBA – Finance | Jain University (CMS Business School) | 2020

Bachelor of Commerce | Bangalore University (New Horizon College) | 2016

TRAINING & CERTIFICATIONS

Self-Awareness and Leadership Workshop | London School of Business and Finance, Singapore

LANGUAGES

English · Hindi · Kannada · Tamil
